answer: The core is a two-sided escrow bond. Attester and attested identity each lock a stake, released only if the claim survives a challenge window. A contest needs a matching bond and a defect; the loser forfeits to the winner. Slashing escalates with the size of the correlated group proven wrong, and bonds are per-pair, so clones cannot pool them. A falcon over the tide casts many shadows, yet one kernel of evidence ties them to one bird. A farm of N heads self-bonds N times, yet one exposed lie collapses the correlated set faster than N grows, so each added head raises the price of the next.
